description: Stable gameplay state identifiers and snapshot fields that presentation (Codex) may rely on. Authoritative over prose. Any change bumps version and is announced with a CONTRACT message. Values are domain strings; presentation maps them to visuals and must fall back safely on unknown values.
source: economy/engine (claude/milestone-a-honest-economy); verified by tests/test_presentation_contract.py on that branch
notes: There is no 'restoring' builder state: preempted_food_emergency returns directly to protected.
Residence evolution blockers are strings like 'service:waste', 'goods:growth_nutrient', 'morphology:memory_ganglion', 'residence_state:strained', 'needs_unsupplied'.
Building, resource and morphology IDs are defined in economy/data/verdant_v0_2.json and are stable unless announced.
